description: Source code for H264 picture and DPB (Decoded Picture Buffer) management in media GPU processing, including class definitions and methods for handling H264 pictures within the media namespace.

classes.name: H264Picture
classes.description: Represents an H264 picture with various picture order and reference flags.

classes.name: H264DPB
classes.description: Manages a collection of H264 pictures, functioning as a Decoded Picture Buffer.

methods.name: H264Picture::H264Picture
methods.description: Constructor initializing H264Picture with default values.

methods.name: H264Picture::~H264Picture
methods.description: Destructor for H264Picture.

methods.name: H264Picture::AsV4L2H264Picture
methods.description: Returns nullptr, placeholder for V4L2 H264 picture conversion.

methods.name: H264Picture::AsVaapiH264Picture
methods.description: Returns nullptr, placeholder for VAAPI H264 picture conversion.

methods.name: H264Picture::AsD3D11H264Picture
methods.description: Returns nullptr, placeholder for D3D11 H264 picture conversion.

methods.name: H264DPB::H264DPB
methods.description: Constructor initializing max_num_pics_ to 0.

methods.name: H264DPB::~H264DPB
methods.description: Destructor for H264DPB.

methods.name: H264DPB::Clear
methods.description: Clears the picture list.

methods.name: H264DPB::set_max_num_pics
methods.description: Sets maximum number of pictures, resizing the internal list if necessary.

methods.name: H264DPB::UpdatePicPositions
methods.description: Updates the dpb_position of each picture.

methods.name: H264DPB::Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific picture from the buffer.

methods.name: H264DPB::DeleteUnused
methods.description: Removes unused pictures that are outputted and not referenced.

methods.name: H264DPB::StorePic
methods.description: Stores a new picture in the buffer.

methods.name: H264DPB::CountRefPics
methods.description: Counts the number of reference pictures.

methods.name: H264DPB::MarkAllUnusedForRef
methods.description: Marks all pictures as not referenced.

methods.name: H264DPB::GetShortRefPicByPicNum
methods.description: Retrieves a short-term reference picture by picture number.

methods.name: H264DPB::GetLongRefPicByLongTermPicNum
methods.description: Retrieves a long-term reference picture by long-term picture number.

methods.name: H264DPB::GetLongRefPicByLongTermIdx
methods.description: Retrieves a long-term reference picture by index.

methods.name: H264DPB::GetLowestFrameNumWrapShortRefPic
methods.description: Gets the short-term reference picture with the lowest frame number wrap.

methods.name: H264DPB::GetNotOutputtedPicsAppending
methods.description: Appends not outputted pictures to provided vector.

methods.name: H264DPB::GetShortTermRefPicsAppending
methods.description: Appends short-term reference pictures to provided vector.

methods.name: H264DPB::GetLongTermRefPicsAppending
methods.description: Appends long-term reference pictures to provided vector.
